metadata.description: One-click install of the management-portal MCP operator for Claude Code — the MCP server plus the full agent discipline (skills, the portal-operator subagent, and the /portal, /portal-project, /portal-continue, /portal-stand-down, /portal-rearm, /channel-coordinate, /channel-join, /rearm-watch and /plain-english commands) and the canon gates: hooks that refuse a call or a turn-end instead of merely reminding you, each with a documented stand-down escape and a /portal-rearm to put them back.

plugins.name: management-portal
plugins.description: Operate the management-portal MCP with the full agent discipline - the core loop, the three gates (read-after-write, completeness, task-breakdown), bottom-up completion, never-fabricate-ids, and board-first - now backed by the canon gates, hooks that refuse a call or a turn-end rather than merely reminding you, each with a documented one-line stand-down escape. Sign in with OAuth on first use; no API key to paste or store. Bundles the MCP server, the management-portal and team-chat-reachability skills, the canon-gates reference, the portal-operator and team-chat-watcher subagents, and the /portal, /rearm-watch, /portal-project, /portal-continue, /channel-coordinate, /channel-join, /portal-stand-down, /portal-rearm and /plain-english commands. New in 1.9.0: the gates make the agent consult the project knowledge graph every phase (CANON-KG-CONSULT, CANON-JOURNAL-GRAPH). Optional on Claude Code 2.1.287+ (Desktop Code tab included): a mod adds a run cockpit — the plan with progress bars, phases, milestones, tasks, done vs remaining — plus a gate control panel, a button for every command with saved presets, a status line, a band, result cards, notifications, a Team Chat wake-up and an idle-run nudge. Additive and never enforcement.
